abstract: PURPOSE: To evaluate the efficacy and toxicity of primary chemotherapy with the schedule E400P in the treatment of patients with early stage II (IIa and IIb) and advanced seminoma of good prognosis according to the international classification (IGCCCG). PATIENTS AND METHODS: Sixty-four patients were included. E400P consisted of cisplatin 25 mg/m2/day and etoposide 100 mg/m2/day for four days, every three weeks. Royal Marsden stages were IIab: 53% and IIc-IV: 47%. Twenty-three percent had high BHCG levels, twenty-seven percent had LDH > 2 x N. Sixty-two patients were of good prognosis according to the Medical Research Council classification. RESULTS: Response rate was 98% (69% complete remission, 29% residual disease). After a median follow-up of 34 months, treatment failure was seen in 7 patients (11%). Neutropenia (32%) was the most relevant grade 3-4 toxicity. Other important grade 3-4 side effects were found in less than 5%. Three-year time to treatment failure (TTF) was 89% (95% confidence intervals (CI): 80%-97%) for all patients, 91% (95% CI: 80%-99%) for stages IIa-b, and 87% (95% CI: 74%-99%) for stages IIc-IV. Three-year overall survival (OS) was 97% (95% CI: 93%-99%) for all patients and 95% (95% CI: 85%-99%) for stages IIa-b. CONCLUSIONS: E400P was a very active and safe regimen in good-prognosis advanced seminoma, with low toxicity rates. Definitive comparisons of this regimen with radiotherapy in stages IIa-b or with the more standard E500P or BEP, could be of interest.
abstract_ja: 目的: 国際分類(IGCCCG)で予後良好と判定された早期病期II(IIa、IIb)および進行セミノーマ患者に対する、E400Pレジメンによる初回化学療法の有効性と毒性を評価すること。患者と方法: 64例を登録した。E400Pはシスプラチン25 mg/m2/日およびエトポシド100 mg/m2/日を4日間、3週間ごとに投与するものである。Royal Marsden病期はIIab 53%、IIc-IV 47%であった。23%で高値のβ-hCG、27%でLDH > 2×正常上限値であった。62例はMedical Research Council分類で予後良好であった。結果: 奏効率は98%(完全寛解69%、残存病変29%)であった。中央追跡期間34か月の時点で、治療不成功は7例(11%)に認められた。好中球減少(32%)が最も重要なグレード3-4の毒性であった。他のグレード3-4の副作用は5%未満であった。全症例の3年治療不成功までの期間(TTF)は89%(95%信頼区間(CI): 80%-97%)、病期IIa-bでは91%(95%CI: 80%-99%)、病期IIc-IVでは87%(95%CI: 74%-99%)であった。3年全生存期間(全生存率)は全症例で97%(95%CI: 93%-99%)、病期IIa-bで95%(95%CI: 85%-99%)であった。結論: E400Pは予後良好な進行セミノーマに対して非常に有効かつ安全なレジメンであり、毒性率は低かった。病期IIa-bにおける放射線療法との比較、あるいはより標準的なE500PまたはBEPとの確定的比較は意義があるかもしれない。
